theorems.name: Submission.lipschitz_uniform_remainder_on_closed_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (L : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (S : Set (Rn n)), LipschitzWith K f → Measurable L → MeasurableSet S → (∀ x ∈ S, HasFDerivAt f (L x) x) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A ⊆ S, IsClosed A ∧ volume (S \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < δ → ‖f y - f x - L x (y - x)‖ ≤ ε' * ‖y - x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
